field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable the IGMP proxy. Add an upstream and at least one downstream interface on the Interfaces tab.

field.label: Fast leave
field.help: A stream never stops while another device that asked for it is still receiving it, in every mode. The modes only decide how fast it stops once the last device has left. Off: after the router checks that nobody else is still receiving (count x interval). On: instantly. Auto: instantly with IGMPv3 devices, after the check with IGMPv2 devices.

field.label: Last member query interval (ms)
field.help: Milliseconds between group specific queries after a leave. Stock igmpproxy used 10000 ms. The RFC default is 1000 ms.

field.label: Last member query count
field.help: Queries sent before forwarding stops when fast leave does not apply. Time to stop = count x interval. Empty uses the robustness value.

field.label: Upstream leave delay (ms)
field.help: Stay joined upstream this long after the last downstream member is gone. Switching back to a channel inside this window is instant. 0 = leave immediately.

field.label: System IGMP version
field.help: Sets net.inet.igmp.default_version, used for the upstream joins and leaves. Some IPTV providers need IGMPv2 to see leaves quickly. Empty leaves the system default.

field.label: Query version
field.help: IGMPv3 queries keep hosts in IGMPv3, where every host reports and sends its leave, so host tracking and auto fast leave are exact. IGMPv2 hosts still work. Choose IGMPv2 only for old equipment that needs it.

field.label: Robustness
field.help: Tolerance for lost packets. Group membership timeout = robustness x query interval + response interval.

field.label: Query interval (s)
field.help: Seconds between general queries on downstream interfaces.

field.label: Query response interval (s)
field.help: Seconds hosts may wait before answering a general query.

field.label: Tracked hosts limit
field.help: Hosts tracked per group per interface. Above it, auto fast leave falls back to the RFC check.

field.label: Proxy SSDP (239.255.255.250)
field.help: By default UPnP discovery traffic is kept local and never joined upstream. Enable only if you really need SSDP from the upstream network.
